methodology.scope: One local host, three real services and PostgreSQL; actual Go managed-memory/goroutine samples, logical byte reservations and key contention. No production capacity or OOM-prevention guarantee.
methodology.mix: 80% pressure operations and 20% unrelated probe work; all routes critical. For hot keys, probes write 16 rotating cold keys. Other probes perform ordinary database reads. Orders receives 60%, catalog/inventory 20% each.
methodology.memory: 8MiB per pressure request, 128MiB Go-managed budget, threshold .65, 50ms sampling, cap2; runtime/OS pages explicitly collected between phases for fixture cleanup
methodology.goroutines: 32 child goroutines per pressure request, count threshold180, 50ms sampling, cap2; count is not a CPU/scheduler measurement
methodology.writes: 128KiB actual persisted value per operation; 256KiB concurrent planned-byte budget; cost computed from validated plan, not request body length
methodology.keys: 16KiB persisted writes; one hot key, 16 cold keys; per-key cap1, registry32, TTL2s, overflow shared
methodology.measurement: Open-loop arrivals, no retries, 3s clients, 4096 generator slots; runtime pressure is sampled and can overshoot/oscillate. TTL measured separately.
